Philosophy Quotes About Hope

Hope sits between resignation and fantasy. These passages explore how expectation orients action, how despair can misdescribe the future, and when hope becomes a virtue rather than a mood.

Quotes / About / Hope

10 quotations on hope

  1. There are more things to admire in men than to despise.
    Albert Camus
    Humanity
  2. the best of all possible worlds
    Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz
    Philosophy
  3. Faith is the bird that feels the light and sings when the dawn is still dark.
    Rabindranath Tagore
    Faith
  4. Hope consists in asserting that there is at the heart of being… a mysterious principle which is in connivance with me.
    Gabriel Marcel
    Hope
  5. Even in the darkest of times we have the right to expect some illumination.
    Hannah Arendt
    Hope
  6. In the midst of winter, I found there was, within me, an invincible summer.
    Albert Camus
    Hope
  7. Forgiveness is the only reaction which does not merely re-act but acts anew and unexpectedly.
    Hannah Arendt
    Philosophy
  8. Abandon all hope, you who enter here.
    Dante Alighieri
    Hope
  9. If the youth are wise, the nation is wise; if the youth are prosperous, the nation is prosperous; if the youth are strong, the nation is strong.
    Liang Qichao
    Philosophy
  10. My own sex, I hope, will excuse me, if I treat them like rational creatures, instead of flattering their fascinating graces.
    Mary Wollstonecraft
    Reason
